def _eval_define(form, env):
    """Evaluate a define form (assigns to env[0])."""
    target = form.cdr.car
    rest = form.cdr.cdr
    
    if isinstance(target, Symbol):
        # (define name expr)
        if not isinstance(rest, Pair) or rest.cdr is not NIL:
            raise SchemeError("malformed define")
        val = eval_expr(rest.car, env, False)
        env[0].vars[target.name] = val
    elif isinstance(target, Pair):
        # (define (name . formals) body...)
        fname = target.car
        if not isinstance(fname, Symbol):
            raise SchemeError("malformed define")
        formals = target.cdr
        body = list_to_python(rest) if is_proper_list(rest) else None
        if body is None or len(body) == 0:
            raise SchemeError("malformed define")
        params, vararg = _parse_formals(formals)
        closure = Closure(params, body, env, vararg)
        env[0].vars[fname.name] = closure
    else:
        raise SchemeError("malformed define")

def _parse_formals(formals):
    if isinstance(formals, Symbol):
        return [], formals
    if formals is NIL:
        return [], None
    if isinstance(formals, Pair):
        params = []
        cur = formals
        while isinstance(cur, Pair):
            if not isinstance(cur.car, Symbol):
                raise SchemeError("malformed formals")
            params.append(cur.car)
            cur = cur.cdr
        if cur is NIL:
            return params, None
        if isinstance(cur, Symbol):
            return params, cur
        raise SchemeError("malformed formals")
    raise SchemeError("malformed formals")
